name: YTLPOWR
recent: YTL Power 于 2026 年 11 月 19 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，并持续通过凭单转换与 ESOS 行使增加上市股份。公司同时发布 2026 年报及第 30 届常年股东大会通知，EPF 在 11 月内多次申报持股变动。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩。
因凭单转换及 ESOS 行使多次发行新股并上市。
发布 2026 年报及第 30 届常年股东大会通知。
risks: EPF 在 11 月内多次申报持股变动。
凭单转换与 ESOS 行使持续增加已发行股份数量。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 MYR 6,325,340,000，净利润为 MYR 423,504,000，净利率 6.7%。营收环比增长 24.4%，净利润环比增长 30.0%；营收同比增长 14.0%，但净利润同比下降 48.2%。

recent_en: YTL Power released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 19 November 2026, and continued to list new shares from warrant conversions and ESOS exercises. The company also issued its 2026 Annual Report and notice of the 30th AGM, while EPF filed multiple changes in its substantial shareholder interest during November.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
Listed new shares multiple times from warrant conversions and ESOS exercises.
Issued the 2026 Annual Report and notice of the 30th AGM.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple changes in its substantial shareholder interest during November.
Warrant conversions and ESOS exercises continued to increase the number of issued shares.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 6,325,340,000 and net income was MYR 423,504,000, with a net margin of 6.7%. Revenue rose 24.4% QoQ and net income rose 30.0% QoQ; revenue grew 14.0% YoY while net income fell 48.2% YoY.
